# Shalomut Map repository instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` for all repository work.

The canonical Agent Skills are:

- `.agents/skills/shalomut-map/SKILL.md` for product and implementation work;
- `.agents/skills/shalomut-tracker/SKILL.md` for session continuity, status,
  progress and handoff;
- `.agents/skills/shalomut-verification/SKILL.md` for tests, runtime evidence
  and readiness checks.

Read the applicable skill before substantial work even when the active Copilot
client does not expose automatic Agent Skills discovery.
